projectLabel: case1111 Lot 12 foundation (STR-12) · 地基首轮
note: Foundation round 1: posts, pile footings and bearers, plus a SCHEMATIC translucent soil block (not a survey, no absolute RL). Bracing and S105 connectors are not modelled. Engineering/visual/AutoCAD acceptance pending.
noteZh: 地基首轮：木桩、桩帽混凝土、托梁，外加半透明示意土体（示意，非测绘，无绝对 RL）；斜撑与 S105 连接件不建几何；工程/视觉/AutoCAD 验收均 pending。

levelNotes.text: Datum CGL = 0 is the model-local reference, NOT an absolute RL. S101 shows FFL 33.70 / FGL 33.00; the architectural concept note says the FFL shown is based on GIS data, and the actual FFL must be verified and adjusted on site to reflect 250 mm above the actual mean existing ground levels across the building platform area. The GIS estimate applies only to FFL 33.70; FGL 33.00 is just the S101 text-layer value. Neither is written into the model as an absolute level.
模型局部基准 CGL=0，并非绝对 RL；S101 有 FFL 33.70 / FGL 33.00。建筑概念图注释：所示 FFL 基于 GIS 数据，实际 FFL 须现场核实并调整到建筑平台范围内实际平均现状地面以上 250 mm；GIS 估值仅指 FFL 33.70，FGL 33.00 只是 S101 文字层上的数。两者均未写入模型绝对标高。
Schematic soil block is a translucent illustration with its top at local CGL=0; it is not surveyed terrain and carries no RL.
示意土体为半透明示意，顶面取局部 CGL=0；非测绘地形，不含绝对 RL。
